def candidate(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); first=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if any(v!=bg for v in row)),None)
    if first is not None:
        row=g[first]
        best_run=0
        c=0
        while c<w:
            if row[c]==bg: c+=1; continue
            v=row[c]; s=c
            while c<w and row[c]==v: c+=1
            best_run=max(best_run,c-s)
        if best_run*2>w:
            out=[r[:] for r in g]; out[first]=[bg]*w; return out
    return [[bg]*w]+[r[:] for r in g[:-1]]
